name: Crystal River guided manatee swim tour (Bird's Underwater, Kings Bay)
coordinateNote: Entrance or parking coordinates from the November 12, 2026 gap review.
navigationDestination: Bird's Underwater Dive Center, 320 NW US Highway 19, Crystal River, FL 34428
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: A guide takes a small boat from the shop's own dock on Kings Bay to wherever the manatees are that morning (often King Spring or the Three Sisters area), then gets in the water with you for passive observation. Wetsuit, mask and snorkel are included. Take the 6 a.m. boat: they are usually first off the dock, before the crowds.
cost: $65 per person for a public tour in peak season (Nov-Apr), $59.95 the rest of the year; private boat (up to 6) $449
access: Tour only, book ahead. Public departures at 6 a.m. (6:30 for a few weeks around the clock changes), 11 a.m. and 2 p.m. daily. Departs from the shop dock, no shuttle. Enclosed pontoons and a changing room in winter. Alternative: Fun 2 Dive's Classic Manatee Swim, about 3 hours, max 12 guests, $75 with gear, from 135 NE 3rd St.

conditions.summary: Tours run daily. From Nov 15 to Mar 31 the refuge closes its manatee sanctuaries to all waterborne activity, so guides snorkel outside the roped areas. One outfitter says that when the Crystal River reading drops below 62.7 F, the swim moves outside the springs into the surrounding Three Sisters area. (source dated read 2026-11-12)

name: Bear Island Campground, Big Cypress National Preserve
coordinateNote: Entrance, parking or campsite coordinates from the November 12, 2026 research.
navigationDestination: Bear Island Campground, Big Cypress National Preserve, FL
navigationNote: Drive to the listed entrance; follow the access description on arrival.
experience: Forty primitive sites with vault toilets; sites 1-12 are open year-round and sites 13-40 from Aug 15 to Apr 15. Every Big Cypress campground now charges a fee and requires a Recreation.gov reservation. Vehicles must stay on pavement or designated areas, and the park counts an idling engine as a generator (allowed 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. only); it does not say how that applies to an electric car.
access: Book and pay ahead. Stay limit: 14 days May 1 - Dec 31; 10 days Jan 1 - Apr 30 Big Cypress is hunted in fall and winter; the preserve's 2026-27 dates were not obtained. Statewide Zone A general gun on private land runs Nov 21, 2026 - Jan 3, 2027.

conditions.summary: All 40 sites are in season on Nov 21 per the 2026 campground sheet; availability was not checked. (source dated read 2026-11-12)
